howto.name: Upload an XML file
howto.text: Select an .xml file up to 500 MB. Common schemas like RSS, Atom, and XHTML are supported.

howto.name: Choose display format
howto.text: Select tree view (collapsible hierarchy) or formatted table view for structured data.

howto.name: Convert and download
howto.text: Click Convert. The XML is rendered into a readable, paginated PDF document.

faq.a: Any well-formed XML file is supported. The tool renders the structure as a readable tree or table — it does not apply XSL transforms.
Yes. Element names, attributes, and values are color-coded for readability in the PDF output.

faq.q: Can I convert large XML files?
faq.a: Files up to 500 MB are supported. Very deeply nested structures may produce many pages.
